Key Findings Across 9 Years

The audits document the financial trajectory of MacDowell under Banks’ management:

YearNotable
FY2017–FY2021Pre-“self-managed” baseline period
FY2022Last year before MacDowell transitioned to self-management
FY2023O&M spending reached $1.7M on $587K budget — building purchase year
FY2024Federal awards supplement, budget violations documented
FY2025$968K operating loss, $667K school administration, $719K balloon payment

Institutional Enabler Question

Whether a single auditor serving the same small charter school for 9 consecutive years provides adequate independent oversight is a question for regulators. Auditor rotation policies exist in many jurisdictions to prevent institutional capture.
